name: zenkai-backend
description: Zenkai Anime & Manga Decoupled Provider Backend API

scripts.build: tsc && esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --footer:js="module.exports = Object.assign(handler, module.exports); module.exports.handler = handler; module.exports.default = handler;" --outfile=dist/app.js && node -e "fs.writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))" && cp dist/app.js dist/index.js && cp dist/app.js app.js && cp dist/app.js app.cjs
